acceptance_scope: Complete R2 exterior, both inner faces as viewed after physical turn-over, service access, antenna-edge locality and all real sandwich sections.
purpose: Close the pre-KiCad physical architecture around direct i8080-8, a fully counted 80-contact M1, mechanically unloaded board retention, direct 5+5 antenna locality and local nRF concurrency, with no onboard video-receiver burden.

policy.base_geometry: R1 bodies are retained only as a collision-tested placement seed and may move during complete R2 optimisation
policy.fixed_body: one exact serial device per rectangle
policy.reserve: a dashed physical allocation, never a component or accepted MPN
policy.silkscreen: none of the inner-face annotations in the generated engineering drawing are PCB silkscreen; every outer-face label must pass a generated no-overlap audit against component bodies, installed cables, mounting keep-outs and covered accessory zones
policy.antenna_identification: Every outward RF port keeps a readable role/band label and gains a compact kit code. A post-assembly colour collar around the connector base and a durable heat-shrink flag on the matching antenna repeat that code; colour is redundant and is never the sole identifier.

antenna_bank_optimization.installation_sequence: five rear SMA ports retain an even pitch and no secondary video connector occupies the free strip above the Cap-Bus slot

body_gap_mm.meaning: G body gap for nominal 1.60-mm PCB, not a pad coordinate or press fit

main_sma_mounting.mechanical_principle: true board-edge straddle: the connector shell spans the PCB edge and is soldered to ground lands on both PCB faces; the 1.75-mm body gap does not clamp the 1.60-mm PCB
main_sma_mounting.ground_load_spreading: both face ground pours with a stitched via fence immediately behind the four shell lands; no substitution may rely on copper adhesion on one PCB face
main_sma_mounting.prototype_load_path: ESP32-DIV-like dual-face soldered edge mount without a shared antenna rail; both-face ground lands and the stitched via fence spread ordinary installation and handling loads, while the enclosure provides local support or strain relief wherever the selected antenna geometry requires it
main_sma_mounting.substitution_rule: reject any cheaper SMA or RP-SMA whose exact 1.6-mm land pattern lacks the two lower-face shell lands or an equivalent through-board mechanical load path; never accept retention by only one PCB face

assembly_process_gate.factory_route: before order, obtain written factory DFM acceptance for the straddling five-land connector, including both-face solder delivery, stencil/paste treatment, fixture and inspection access
assembly_process_gate.fallback_route: if factory dual-face wetting is not accepted, reject this MPN and select an exact factory-placeable dual-face or through-board equivalent before release; owner post-PCBA soldering is forbidden
assembly_process_gate.acceptance_record: retain one traceable record per connector with both-face photographs, five visibly wetted rectangular joints, continuity and zero shell movement before antenna fitment

hobby_grade_preorder_verification.scope: non-destructive pre-order design review and ordinary prototype assembly only; no drop, shaker/vibration, prescribed mating-cycle count or consumed sample
hobby_grade_preorder_verification.design_analysis_inputs: exact connector, antenna, PCB and enclosure geometry plus manufacturer-published installation and mechanical limits; any missing antenna mass, lever arm, handling load or enclosure-support limit remains an explicit design-analysis input rather than an invented qualification load
hobby_grade_preorder_verification.structural_requirements: dual-face shell lands and the stitched via fence spread solder load; the enclosure must provide local support or strain relief whenever the selected antenna creates a material lever load, and no solder joint may be the sole user-load path
hobby_grade_preorder_verification.checks: verify exact geometry, land pattern, clearances and DRC; perform a static worst-case calculation only where both the applied load and manufacturer limit are sourced; during ordinary assembly/disassembly inspect both faces, shell movement and solder joints, check continuity, and repeat the owning RF criterion

verification_gates.H5: lock both exact MPNs, released drawings, rectangular five-land coordinates, antenna test set and an executable factory or controlled post-PCBA dual-face soldering process; no sample purchase is authorized here
verification_gates.H7: after assembly, inspect and photograph all five solder joints on every populated connector on the one assembled prototype from both PCB faces; reject incomplete wetting, cracks, lift, bridges or shell movement before antenna fitment
verification_gates.H8: assemble and disassemble the enclosure and approved antennas as normally required for bring-up, using manufacturer-published installation limits; inspect for shell movement and solder/copper damage, check continuity, and repeat the owning VNA, sensitivity, noise or capacitance criterion; no artificial ageing, prescribed cycle count, drop or vibration programme is required

main_sma_mounting.comparison_reference: ESP32-DIV v2 top/bottom Gerbers at commit 9d4d82fe7a12febf554b12e1eca6d434ebe79d39 provide the durable comparison for the same dual-face edge-soldering principle; exact connector identity is not inferred
